{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Drop refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
df_final = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate within each customer segment, by channel
# This is a stratified analysis to adjust for confounding
grouped_stratified = df_final.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='channel')

# Compute the difference in conversion rates within each segment
within_segment_diff = grouped_stratified['email'] - grouped_stratified['paid_search']

# Compute segment proportions in the population
segment_size = df_final['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Compute weighted average of within-segment differences
weighted_diff = (within_segment_diff * segment_size).sum()

# Print all required values
print('Within-segment differences in conversion rate (email - paid_search):')
print(within_segment_diff)
print('\nSegment proportions in the population:')
print(segment_size)
print(f'\nWeighted average difference (email - paid_search): {weighted_diff}')"}
